caption: The drawing depicts two flintlock pistols positioned horizontally and parallel, one above the other, with the barrels pointing to the right. Both pistols feature distinct curved wooden grips, brown in color with darker shading to suggest depth and form. The barrels are cylindrical, depicted in a mahogany-brown color, and each pistol includes metallic components, such as triggers and hammers, rendered in a slightly darker brown. The pistols have similar proportions and design, with detailing around the hammer, trigger guard, and barrel attachments. The background of the drawing is a plain, light beige color, devoid of any additional elements or decorations, which makes the pistols the central focus of the composition.
title: Cap and Ball Revolver
